Format: exact paper headers present (REWARD_MACHINE/STATES/INITIAL_STATE/FINAL_STATES/TRANSITION_FUNCTION/REWARD_FUNCTION); FINAL_STATES is nonempty, u6 is declared in STATES and is the accepting state for the task (reached only on at_exit & holding_box). Reward entries mirror transitions one-to-one with implicit 0 elsewhere. Semantics vs. the task's two clauses: (1) 'reach the exit carrying the box' — every guard into u6 requires at_exit & holding_box; exiting without the box falls through the else self-loops in u0/u1/u2 and pays nothing, matching the env's 0 payment when the require condition fails. (2) 'pick up on the very next move after each fall' — box_fell (an event, correctly used as an edge) routes to pending states u3/u4 on the fall step; on the very next step holding_box pays 0.1 (u3→u1, u4→u2) while !holding_box traps in u5, an absorbing failure state with no path to u6, so a single missed reaction permanently voids the terminal reward — correct for this conjunctive task. Timing is sound: box_fell and holding_box never co-occur, box_fell and at_exit never co-occur, and after a fall only a successful pickup can make holding_box true, so 'next step holding_box' is exactly 'next move picked it up'; the recovery reward lands on the correct transition. Coverage/ordering: each state's guards plus else are total; guard precedence is consistent; siren_ringing and switch_toggled are irrelevant to this task, never appear in guards, and are absorbed by per-state else self-loops. The u0/u1/u2 fall counters are exhaustive for this environment (at most two fired falls: only the first and second pickup schedule falls, later pickups cause none, skipped falls do not return), and counting observed box_fell events rather than internal pickup indices stays correct when fall 1 is skipped and only fall 2 fires. Reward safety/boundedness: rewards are paid only for compliant behavior (0.1 per recovery, at most 2 → ≤0.2; 1.0 at compliant exit; max total 1.2); no reward path exists from u5 and exit without the box is never rewarded. Reachability/compactness: all seven states are reachable, u6 is reachable with zero, one, or two recovered falls, and 7 states is proportionate. Minor non-blocking notes: the (u3,u4)→u6 'at_exit & holding_box' guards and their reward entries are unsatisfiable (the step after a fall cannot be both exit and holding) — harmless dead code; the empty else catch-alls in u3/u4 are unreachable; and the 0.1 recovery bonus means a fall-plus-recovery episode can total 1.1–1.2 versus 1.0 for a fall-free exit, which is benign shaping since falls are exogenous and the bonus is only ever paid for compliant reactions.

All five environment-declared propositions are defined exactly once, with no extra functions and none missing. Each implementation matches the documented API expression: siren_ringing reads env.siren_ringing (persistent, current siren state); switch_toggled and box_fell test membership in env.events_this_step (event semantics, true only on the step the event fires); holding_box checks env.carrying is not None with type 'box' (persistent, guarded against None); at_exit reads the cell at env.agent_pos via env.grid.get with a proper None guard before accessing .type, matching the goal-cell check. All functions return plain booleans, use only documented read-only API, contain no imports, no actions, no side effects, and do not mutate the environment or episode memory. Syntax is valid and each function is executable as given. The declared predicates siren_ringing and switch_toggled are not used in this reward machine's transitions, but they are required members of the declared proposition set and are correctly implemented, so they are not grounds for rejection.
